core: Urea cycle and glutamate/aspartate-family amino acid metabolism
qualifier: malate-aspartate shuttle
name: Urea cycle, glutamate/aspartate metabolism and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: Members cover the urea cycle and its inborn errors, ornithine/arginine/citrulline, glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate metabolism and ammonium handling; urea-cycle content separates it from C1/C3/C4 and the malate-aspartate shuttle is what it has over the broader amino acid theme C2.

qualifier: dorsoventral patterning and adenohypophysis development
name: Forebrain dorsoventral patterning and adenohypophysis development
rationale: All three members concern early forebrain shaping (morphogenesis, D/V patterning, anterior pituitary), unlike confusables about cortical migration, neural plate/hindbrain, progenitor division or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: receptor signaling and its regulation
name: Type II interferon signaling and its regulation
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma receptor signaling, its MAPK branch and its (negative) regulation, whereas confusables cover IL-10/IL-12/IL-27 family signaling or Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma production.

qualifier: iron, heme, copper and manganese
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members span transferrin/ferroportin/DMT1 iron handling, heme scavenging and copper, manganese and cobalt transport; copper/manganese separate it from iron-only confusables and heme/transferrin from cadmium-centred ones.

qualifier: cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
name: Cullin neddylation, deneddylation and protein stability regulation
rationale: Members concern neddylation/deneddylation of cullin ligases (COP9 signalosome, CUL1/CUL3-RHOBTB adaptors) and protein (de)stabilization, distinguishing it from deubiquitinase, PD-L1 degradation and chaperone-folding confusables.

qualifier: alkylation damage reversal and TET-TDG active DNA demethylation
name: Base excision repair, alkylation reversal and active DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover glycosylase recognition, AP-site processing and gap filling of BER plus MGMT/ALKBH alkylation reversal, NEIL3 crosslink resolution and TET/TDG demethylation, which the OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1-defect confusables lack.

core: Muscle cell growth and differentiation regulation
qualifier: vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and cardiomyocyte proliferation/hypertrophy
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and cardiomyocyte growth regulation
rationale: Members regulate VSMC proliferation, migration, differentiation and phenotypic switching together with cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophy and adaptation; the VSMC content separates it from heart-development C1 and the cardiac content from vascular-remodeling C2-C4.

qualifier: olfactory, trigeminal/facial nerve and lacrimal/salivary gland
name: Olfactory, cranial nerve and craniofacial gland development
rationale: Members concern nose, olfactory and trigeminal/facial nerve development, GnRH neuron migration, taste papillae and lacrimal/salivary glands, whereas confusables are hindbrain or inner/outer ear development.

qualifier: downstream of TLR, NOD and TNF receptors via TAK1/IKK
name: TLR, NOD and TNF receptor signaling to NF-kappaB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members describe TAK1/IKK/NIK activation of canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB and JNK/p38 from TLR, NOD, TNFR-family and antigen receptors, unlike confusables centred on T cell activation, cytokine production or endosomal TLR deficiencies.

qualifier: excitatory: neuroligin, NMDA receptor and PSD-95 clustering
name: Neuroligin-driven excitatory postsynapse assembly and NMDA receptor clustering
rationale: All members concern neurexin-neuroligin-driven postsynaptic membrane assembly with NMDA receptor and PSD-95 clustering, distinguishing it from inhibitory gephyrin/GABA-receptor and presynaptic/adhesion confusables.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocyte differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC/progenitor maintenance, RUNX1 programmes, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and early myeloid progenitors, while confusables focus on granulocyte/monocyte or lymphoid differentiation and other RUNX targets.

qualifier: antibacterial/antifungal killing, agglutination and cytolysis
name: Innate antibacterial and antifungal killing, agglutination and cytolysis
rationale: Members concern host killing, lysis and agglutination of bacteria and fungi (neutrophil killing, metal sequestration, mucosal defense, peptidoglycan handling), whereas confusables centre on defensins and antimicrobial peptide production.

qualifier: COX/PLA2 prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptors
name: Prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2/COX prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis and its regulation plus prostanoid and leukotriene receptor signaling, while confusables are leukotriene/lipoxin synthesis or P450 eicosanoid metabolism.

core: Renal control of blood volume and pressure
qualifier: renin-angiotensin, natriuresis and guanylyl cyclase cGMP signaling
name: Renal blood pressure control: angiotensin, natriuresis and cGMP signaling
rationale: Members concern renin-angiotensin and renal regulation of blood volume, sodium excretion and urine volume, with cGMP/receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling that the angiotensin-metabolism and vasoconstriction confusables lack.

qualifier: COPII and COPI coats
name: COPII and COPI vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members cover COPII cargo loading/budding, vesicle tethering and COPI anterograde, intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic, unlike ER quality control, Golgi organization or COPI-independent retrograde confusables.

qualifier: fatty acid alpha/beta/omega-oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover very-long/branched-chain fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation and 24/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis with related disorders, while confusables add peroxisome biogenesis, fatty acid elongation or cholesterol biosynthesis.

core: Sulfur, selenium and methylamine compound catabolism
qualifier: choline/trimethylamine oxidation and carnitine synthesis
name: Transsulfuration, selenium methylation and choline/trimethylamine catabolism
rationale: Members combine transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid catabolism, selenium compound methylation, and choline catabolism, FMO trimethylamine oxidation and carnitine synthesis; the choline/FMO arm separates it from sulfur/B6 confusables and the sulfur/selenium arm from the carnitine confusable.

qualifier: structural events: condensation, cohesion, spindle, nuclear envelope, cytokinesis
name: Mitotic structural events: chromosome cohesion, spindle, nuclear envelope, cytokinesis
rationale: Members span chromosome condensation and cohesion, centromere/kinetochore, centrosome and spindle assembly, nuclear envelope breakdown/reformation and cytokinesis, whereas confusables are chromatin assembly, APC/C-driven mitotic exit or meiotic recombination.

qualifier: axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry determination
name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry determination
rationale: Members concern axonemal dynein arm/central apparatus assembly, sperm axoneme and mucociliary clearance plus left-right axis specification, which the multiciliogenesis/basal body confusables lack.

qualifier: astral microtubule-cortex interactions
name: Spindle positioning via astral microtubule-cortex interactions
rationale: Members concern spindle localization and orientation, astral microtubules, microtubule stabilization and cortical/actin protein localization, unlike centrosome positioning, tubulin modification or centrosome maturation confusables.

qualifier: glucose/lipid sensing by ChREBP, SREBP, LXR, PPARA and clock factors
name: Glucose- and lipid-sensing transcriptional control of lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are transcriptional responses to sugar and fatty acids (ChREBP, SREBP, LXR, PPARA, PGC-1alpha, circadian nuclear receptors) governing triglyceride, lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis, unlike glucagon/PKA, adipogenesis or cholesterol-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: choline uptake, acetylcholine release and nicotinic receptors
name: Cholinergic transmission: choline uptake, acetylcholine release, nicotinic receptors
rationale: Members cover SLC5A7 choline uptake, acetylcholine synthesis and secretion, neuromuscular transmission and nicotinic receptors, distinguishing it from NMJ assembly, muscarinic/serotonin, neurotoxin and GABA-transport confusables.

qualifier: ATM sensing, non-homologous end joining and HR/NHEJ choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, end joining and HR/NHEJ choice
rationale: Members concern ATM-mediated DSB sensing, classical and alternative NHEJ and regulation of HR versus NHEJ, whereas confusables cover BRCA1/2 defects, end resection and homologous recombination proper.

qualifier: astral microtubule organization
name: Mitotic spindle orientation and astral microtubule organization
rationale: All four members concern spindle localization/orientation, spindle assembly and astral microtubules, unlike centrosome positioning, neuroblast asymmetric division or centrosome maturation confusables.

qualifier: Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12 signaling to Rac/WAVE/Arp2/3
name: Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12-driven actin remodeling for phagocytosis
rationale: Members link Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signaling to Rac, WASP/WAVE and Arp2/3 actin polymerization for phagocytic cups and macrophage fusion, unlike BCR, Rac GTPase-cycle or inhibitory Fc receptor confusables.
